notes: Right file, right area, focused fix. Minor markdown-rendering touch in a sibling helper is justified because the bug is about how bullets render. No sprawl.
input:
## Issue summary

DOCX converter strips bullet points from nested lists. Three-level nested lists in test fixture `report.docx` lose all bullets after the second level. Expected bullets preserved at every depth; observed depths 3+ rendered as plain paragraphs.

## Files touched

```
src/converters/docx_converter.py
src/converters/_list_helpers.py
tests/test_docx_converter.py
```

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/converters/docx_converter.py b/src/converters/docx_converter.py
--- a/src/converters/docx_converter.py
+++ b/src/converters/docx_converter.py
@@ -211,9 +211,11 @@ class DocxConverter:
     def _render_list_item(self, paragraph, depth):
-        if depth > MAX_DEPTH:
-            return paragraph.text
-        return self._render_with_bullet(paragraph, depth)
+        # Previously bailed at MAX_DEPTH=2, dropping the bullet for
+        # anything deeper. Bullets should render at every depth; only
+        # the indent prefix needed to scale.
+        return self._render_with_bullet(paragraph, depth)

diff --git a/src/converters/_list_helpers.py b/src/converters/_list_helpers.py
--- a/src/converters/_list_helpers.py
+++ b/src/converters/_list_helpers.py
@@ -22,3 +22,5 @@ def indent_for_depth(depth):
+    # MAX_DEPTH guard removed alongside the docx_converter call site
+    return '  ' * depth + '- '

diff --git a/tests/test_docx_converter.py b/tests/test_docx_converter.py
--- a/tests/test_docx_converter.py
+++ b/tests/test_docx_converter.py
@@ -45,3 +45,12 @@ def test_two_level_list():
+
+def test_three_level_nested_list_keeps_bullets():
+    out = convert_fixture('report.docx')
+    # All three depths render with a bullet prefix
+    assert out.count('\n- ') == 1   # depth 0
+    assert out.count('\n  - ') == 1   # depth 1
+    assert out.count('\n    - ') == 1 # depth 2 (was missing pre-fix)
```
